text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock B and Stock C after sizable gains, but a gain versus my average cost alone is not a reason to sell; I should decide using each holding’s role and prospects, not just its separate-account score.","I should judge risk and progress at the portfolio level, not let my dislike of realizing a loss keep me holding a position or make me treat each stock in isolation.","These few periods do not show that past price moves predict future ones; I should avoid trading on short-term patterns and make deliberate choices that fit my risk tolerance."]}
